source_ownership: Hypercurve owns complete planar image/traversal proof and source-bound views. HyperBRep owns spatial construction, whole-shell admission, native replay and regularized common-profile interval composition. HyperBRep IO is unchanged and owns the next exact STEP entity/chart/encoding work. Dependency locks and non-BREP shared-ledger bytes are unchanged.
limits: The image view retains the borrowed original curve, but its native segment has its own chart. The live extrusion retains the original normalized region; native archives replay exact geometry and regenerate admission facts, not the complete authoring graph or an original-to-native parameter map. Strict local certification does not upgrade an earlier source construction. Four original selected parabola Boolean/affine profiles and the nonlinear parallel cap remain unsupported. STEP export of the new uncut solid reports UnsupportedCurve(RationalBezier) at body 0, edge 0; later surface requirements are not tested by that rejection. General selected-parameter integration, analytic parallel spatial carriers, unequal-profile stepped shells, general surface Booleans, operation-wide work/retained-heap/cancellation bounds, full coverage/formal/fuzz/ASan/lexicase gates, registry/MSRV/real binding delivery and complete STEP/AP support remain open. Existing cost and thin-layer OCCT limitations remain recorded. Source-path WASM and Cargo membership are not shipped consumer qualification. All 28 work packages remain open or in progress. No push or complete pre-push claim. Necessary supporting-crate changes belong in their owners; unrelated upstream breakage remains with the concurrent thread.
